name: superheat-gas-boiler
title: Superheat Gas Boiler
author: adamo
description: This mod is not standalone and intended to be used with other mods. Adds superheat gas boiler that consumes fluids with fuel_value, has max. consumption of 11.6 MW and generates superheated (500 °C) steam. Generates 120/s steam and can supply two steam turbines.
